subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Many bosses at workplace consider their __subordinate__ on equal planes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Superior'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word **'subordinate'** refers to someone who holds a lower or lesser position or rank. (अधीनस्थ) 

 
 
• **Example:** The manager asked his subordinates to complete the project on time.
 
 
 
• The chosen antonym** 'superior'** indicates someone who is higher in rank, position, or status. ('श्रेष्ठ' or 'अधिकारी')
 
 
• **Example:** She had a meeting with her superior to discuss her annual performance.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Superior**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Inferior' **suggests less worth or lower quality or rank. Its Hindi equivalent is 'हीन' or 'नीचे'.
 
• **'Ordinary'** means with no special or distinctive features; normal. Its Hindi equivalent is 'साधारण'.
 
• **'Mediocre'** refers to only moderate quality; not very good. Its Hindi equivalent is 'माध्यमिक'.
